item.title: Awaji Hanasajiki: Hillside Flower Fields Above the Sea — Guide
item.description: Hanasajiki — the name means ‘flower balcony’ — is a hillside park on the northern tip of Awaji Island, planted with vast single-colour blocks of flowers that change through the year: rape blossom and poppies in spring, salvia and marigolds in summer, and a famous sweep of cosmos in autumn. The slope faces north-east toward Osaka Bay, so the flowers are seen against sea and sky rather than a backdrop of trees, and paths run right through the plantings.
